about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Third Sunday after Easter” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: We beseech Thee, O Lord, may the Sacraments which we have received restore us with spiritual food and protect us with bodily aid. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
